title: Panthers GM Dan Morgan: If Andy Dalton trade possibility came up, we'd let him explore it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Panthers GM Dan Morgan: If Andy Dalton trade possibility came up, we'd let him explore it
sources.description: If another team wants to make a bid to acquire quarterback Andy Dalton in a trade with the Panthers, it sounds like General Manager Dan Morgan will be amenable to working with them.
